name: Canonical Context Builder
purpose: Reconstruct and maintain the single canonical truth of a project from fragmented conversations, files, renames, decisions and prior outputs.
triggers: project has accumulated many chats/files/versions with no single source of truth
need a clean handoff to a new agent/conversation/collaborator
need to separate current decisions from deprecated proposals
need to update canon after a completed phase
non_triggers: generic summarization with no canonical-state requirement
producing an implementation plan from canon
minimum_inputs: project materials or current canonical artifact
quality_gates: no deprecated decision appears as current
handoff references canonical artifacts, not conversational memory
stop_conditions: all five required artifacts produced and contradiction/staleness pass run -> COMPLETE
sources too sparse/contradictory for a minimal FACTS section -> BLOCKED, state what is needed
never present an unresolved conflict as resolved
